policy: Full texts from public-domain sources; modern readings are metadata and external links only. Themes are editorial browsing paths.
attribution: Poetry data from PoetryDB (https://poetrydb.org), licensed under CC BY 4.0. Original poem texts are public domain.
derivation: Initial Poetry I Like collection; source metadata and per-record rights retained from the licensed November 8 snapshot.
editorialChanges: 114 empty reading notes receive an original generic reading prompt. Original source and rights metadata are retained. Krynicki’s modern reading note uses factual reader-facing wording; source links, rights and poem counts are unchanged.
translationPolicy: Stored AI-generated English translations of public-domain originals. Not published translations; no human review is claimed.
referencePolicy: Exact readable modern poem pages only. No protected verse or modern translation is included.
